title: We built a self-improving macro thesis engine that forecasts what the market hasn't priced in yet.
author: Depth4dotcom
selftext:
By the time a chart moves, the move is mostly over. DEPTH4 maps the chain of consequences *before* the price reacts, surfacing live, tradeable SIGNALS across equities, rates, FX, and commodities.

Its core differentiator is "*Blind Spot*"—a mathematically verified metric showing exactly how much of a macro move the market has yet to price in. Instead of relying on AI guesswork, DEPTH4 calculates this blind spot using real Wall Street options data and realized volatility. If the market is underpricing a catalyst, DEPTH4 flags it.

Unlike static AI tools, DEPTH4 is built on a self-calibrating, three-layer memory architecture:

\*   **It knows its own edge:** Before writing a thesis, the engine checks its 90-day historical win rate for the specific macro mechanism it is trading (e.g., "CTA trend unwinding") and hard-clamps its own conviction based on its actual track record. 

\*   **It remembers:** It uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to review its past successful and failed theses for that exact setup, learning from structural mistakes before generating a new trade plan.

\*   **It evolves its playbook:** Every week, the AI reviews its worst trades, proposes new rules to prevent repeating mistakes, tests them against a historical regression suite, and injects the approved rules into its own brain for all future generations.

The output is the *SIGNALS page*—a live dashboard that rolls up all active theses on an asset into one clear card showing direction (Long/Short/Mixed), signal strength, and unpriced Room. Every signal is fully drillable, meaning users never face a "black box" prediction. They can see the exact D1–D4 causal chain, the underlying evidence timeline, and the mathematical reasoning behind the edge.

DEPTH4 doesn't just tell you what happened. It proves *why* an asset is about to move, calculates *how much* is left to gain, and continuously sharpens its own intelligence over time.
